[binaries]
c = 'gcc'
ar = 'ar'
strip = 'strip'
pkgconfig = 'pkg-config'
ld = 'ld'

c_native = 'gcc'
cpp_native = 'g++'

[built-in options]
c_args = ['-m32']
c_link_args = ['-m32']

[properties]
# Same CPU family as the amd64 build host (gcc-multilib, not a separate
# cross-gcc), so the 32-bit binaries run directly, no qemu needed.
needs_exe_wrapper = false

[host_machine]
system = 'linux'
cpu_family = 'x86'
cpu = 'i686'
endian = 'little'
